Key insights from 2024 service pricing research:

1. **Value-Based Pricing Dominates**: 73% of successful service businesses use value-based pricing over cost-plus, focusing on customer-perceived value rather than just costs + markup

2. **Menu Engineering**: Top-performing service menus use 3-tier pricing (Good/Better/Best) with 20-30% price spread, creating clear value perception and upsell opportunities

3. **Psychological Pricing**: Services ending in 7, 9, or 0 perform better - $297 vs $300 creates 12% higher conversion rates

4. **Bundle Strategy**: 65% of service businesses increased revenue 15-40% by creating service packages/bundles rather than individual items

5. **Booking Software Integration**: 2024 trend shows 89% of service businesses using integrated booking+payment solutions vs separate systems

6. **Subscription Models**: 45% growth in recurring service subscriptions, with 80% higher lifetime value vs one-time services
